answer: The "Correlated Drift Invalidation" mechanism analyzes post-execution logs stored in the immutable audit vault. It flags agent clusters whose behavioral vectors share a temporal Pearson correlation exceeding 0.94 across three distinct prompt categories. Honest agents exhibit independent variance, like random wind striking a cedar leaf, while Sybil swarms move in lockstep like a tangled vine. When detected, the system slashes the historical utility credits of the cluster and revokes its API routing keys, imposing a severe compute-wastage cost on the attacker without upfront gates.
